'''Flight deck 11C''' was located on an [[Imperial supply depot (Rainos Cluster)|Imperial supply depot]] established in the [[Rainos Cluster/Legends|Rainos Cluster]]. It was targeted by an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] team as an entry point during a [[Mission to the Imperial supply depot|mission]] to obtain [[KL-45 coolant hydro-valve]]s from the facility.<ref name="M">{{WEGCite|story=Meltdown (adventure)|book=Instant Adventures}}</ref>
